summary: I am responsible for all of Webel's web: the B2C app, the B2B platform behind company profiles, the internal dashboard, SEO, email, and the component library the three products share.
highlights: The B2C app is used by thousands of people a day. I migrated its marketplace from Angular to React.
The company profiles working on the B2B platform generate close to 25% of GMV, over €500k a year.
I extracted the design system into a library shared by B2C, B2B, and the dashboard, and moved email to React Email.
